## The machines

```{=html}
{{< include images/_machines.svg >}}
```

::: {.notes}
Two machines and a tunnel. The laptop runs the browser and TalkWithZombies; the AI runs on a GPU box, a VM on
Hyperstack for the demo, or a home lab PC with a 3090. One command installs the client, one deploys the AI; during the
show, an SSH tunnel brings the box's three services to the laptop's localhost. Where things run, not how the playbook
works (that is the deep dive).
:::
